1. Deep Squat Hold — 2×20-30s (warm-up, check pain-free range)
2. Banded Glute Bridges — 2×15
3. Back Squat — 4×8 @ ≤50 lb (hard cap, focus tracking/tempo not load)
4. Single-Leg RDL — 3×8/leg
5. Calf Raises (single leg) — 3×12/leg
6. Dead Bug — 2×8/side

Stop any set if knee pain or swelling shows up. Progress by reps/tempo before touching the 50 lb ceiling.
